integrity: All formulas proved by local structure and cyclic gaps. Finite exhaustive checks are supplemental rather than a substitute for unrestricted proofs. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: General weight-polynomial sums are exponential in the base-graph order; the transfer construction specializes to cycle bases. Priority risk remains from an inaccessible full 2023 rooted-product paper. All findings are subject to independent validation.
source_ids: Siva Parvathi and Maheswari, Independent Roman Domination of Corona Graph (2017), https://www.ijarcs.info/index.php/Ijarcs/article/viewFile/4489/3963
title: Exact independent-Roman weight enumerators for clique coronas and minimum sunlet configurations
